traps: Usually one flat sitemap with no index: products, categories and pages mixed (ledemag.ro: 1683 URLs; zevo.ro: 807).
With SEO URLs off, pages are index.php?route=... addresses.

typicalProblems.explanation: Produsele apar la Google cu adrese de tip index.php?route=product&product_id=513, fara niciun cuvant din numele produsului. Adresa nu ajuta la pozitionare si arata neincrezator in rezultate.
